name: Advanced Engineering Electromagnetics
description: Review of basic mathematical tools, time-varying and time-harmonic electromagnetic fields: Maxwell’s equations, boundary conditions, circuit field relations, power and energy; categorization of materials from electromagnetic standpoint; wave equations and its solutions; wave propagation in unbounded medium; polarization; reflection and transmission at planar interface(s); auxiliary vector potentials; construction of solutions; radiation and scattering equations; electromagnetic theorems, waveguides; introduction to any other relevant topic(s) (for example surface waves, optical fibers etc.).
